LF is another game I got to play on Apple Arcade before with mixed impressions. I couldn’t complete it because the controls felt off, it wasn’t clear how certain controls worked and it got frustrating near world 4 or 5. The steam version was recently on sale for €1,74 and I got curious enough to give it another try. This version feels better but I can’t say for certain nor can I pinpoint clear improvements. The bigger screen definitely makes things easier to spot and the controls feel tighter even though time is still needed to get used to them. This is a physics based platformer that requires precision if you want to get all the 3 stars which are completing a level without getting hit, complete a level within a certain time and collect all the gold. The 20 levels are short when you run through them normally/quickly but it took me 9.4 hours to get all the stars and the achievements for the 3 mini-games & cogwheels. 

I find the graphics to be appealing, there is a bit of voice acting which is charming, the story has some twists, the levels are well made and you can get the stars separately. I do dislike some design decisions though. When you get hit once you die straight away, it’s not too much of a problem since there are plenty of checkpoints but it can make the no hit stars more frustrating. There is also hardcore mode unlocked after completing the game once. You’re supposed to complete the entire game without a hit and there is an achievement for it. I find this to be a big miss since the physics based controls are simply not that precise and it is very easy to move to an opposite direction by accident. I tried and gave up quickly, that achievement is simply not worth the effort. The rest of the achievements were fine.

The game costs €7 normally. It might not be worth it to some if you run quickly through the game but it’s a good price if you take your time and get all the stars. LF is a polished platformer with few issues. I can recommend it for fans of the genre unless you’re a completionist who has to get 100%. Even though I didn’t get the hardcore achievement, I’m still glad I gave this game another chance.

В сочетании с ачивкой  - не умирать за всю игру это вообще жесть.
Такие игры создаются исключительно с целью, чтоб игрок в них страдал, ничего больше. Играть в такое и получать удовольствие от этого - то еще извращение.
